name: Yemọja (Yoruba)

domain_history.domain: river deity, specifically associated with the Ògùn River in Nigeria

notes: Weaker sourcing than Ògún/Ṣàngó/Ọ̀ṣun — no single named academic monograph specifically on Yemọja comparable to Badejo's on Ọ̀ṣun was located. The river-to-ocean domain shift in the Americas is widely attested across sources but the specific causal mechanism is not traced to one named academic citation — see claim.
